title: The Sultan of the Mamluks agrees to betroth his daughter Aiman to Saʿd, heir of Granada: the alliance with Cairo is now a bond of blood
The Chancellor reports that the heir Saʿd, not yet three, is a Prodigy, and the court begins to whisper that he may be the ruler to lead the Emirate out of the darkness
source: Trent's screenshot of the event and his account (January 1351)

title: The finest tutors of the Islamic world, and several Christians among them, are summoned to Gharnāṭa to begin the extensive education of the heir Saʿd
